device.model: local docker compose (cloud container, 4 vCPU): trial stack from smoke-trial.sh, stand-in second provider (MinIO, compliance lock) in the same project

notes: ADR 0051 point-in-time restore: the latest WAL-G base backup fetched from the second provider and decrypted with the offline private key, WAL replayed up to the target time, then the restored state checked by a query. Partial unless run on a separate host against the real second provider (the monthly drill). Timings inside the restore container have one-second resolution (busybox date). wal_push_after_switch_s: from pg_switch_wal to the segment holding the post-target commit being archived; with archive_timeout 300 s the bound on loss is about 5 minutes plus that push time, against the plan's 15. Small synthetic database; the monthly drill on a separate host measures the real size.
